scope: Known measured components, not exhaustive total. Main value is final completed run only; earlier interrupted child trees incompletely metered. Replay direct/audit body values omit startup. Full-log parent CPU, preliminary first-row check, tool overhead, Docker daemon/build/container CPU and some preparation/fixture CPU unknown; package gate separately metered. Child totals are not also added from inner tasks. Concurrent wall times cannot be summed as wall duration.
